axes: Roblox (x, y, z) = Blender (x, z, -y); asset front = Roblox LookVector (-Z); base on y = 0

assets.name: knife
assets.notes: Clip-point survival knife: carbon-steel blade with a saber grind and honed edge, oval steel guard, stacked-leather-washer handle with fibre spacers, steel pommel with peened tang nut. Grip (handle centre) at origin, blade +Z, edge +Y.

assets.name: machete
assets.notes: Latin machete with an upswept tip: blackened carbon steel worn to bare metal at the edge (file-sharpened band), full tang between hardwood scales with three brass-lined rivets, cord lanyard. Grip at origin.

assets.name: hatchet
assets.notes: Bearded hatchet: hand-forged head left black with forge scale, the bit ground bright; hickory haft (oval, swelled knob) with hand grime, wedged through the eye. Grip at origin, bit faces +Y.

assets.name: spear
assets.notes: 7-stud ash spear: hand-forged leaf head with a diamond midrib and bright honed edges on a riveted conical socket, cord binding, leather grip at the balance point (origin), torn red rag, iron butt spike.

assets.name: mace
assets.notes: Forged flanged mace: six pointed flanges on an iron core with a top spike, collar and riveted langets down an oak haft, leather-wrapped grip, iron pommel. Grip at origin, a flange faces +Y.

assets.name: sword
assets.notes: Arming sword: lenticular blade with a fuller, honed edges, forged crossguard, leather grip over cord risers with cord-bound ends, aged brass wheel pommel with a peened tang. Grip at origin.

assets.name: bow
assets.notes: Traditional recurve: ash limbs with horn tip overlays, walnut riser with an arrow shelf, stitched leather grip, waxed linen string with dark centre serving and a brass nock point. Grip at origin; string centre / Nock at z = 0.2 so the arrow clears the hand; ArrowRest on the -X side of the riser window. bow_Rope = string + serving + nock bead (hide it while drawing and draw Beams StringTop -> Nock -> StringBottom).

assets.name: arrow
assets.notes: Cedar arrow: horn nock insert (origin = nock throat = Grip = Nock; slot along Y), three shield-cut turkey fletchings (barred red cock feather points +X), sinew bindings, socketed steel broadhead. Align arrow +Y with the bow string.

assets.name: throwing_knife
assets.notes: One-piece stonewashed throwing knife: double-edged spear-point blade, flat tang under an olive paracord wrap, steel ring pommel. Grip at origin, blade +Z.

assets.name: water_bottle
assets.notes: Heavy old green-tinted bottle glass (seed bubbles, mould seams, smudges) holding water, knurled tin screw cap, stitched leather sleeve. Grip = body centre at origin. Glass and WaterFill use AlphaMode Transparency with MeshPart.Transparency 0.02 (alpha = opacity).

assets.name: empty_bottle
assets.notes: The same bottle, empty and open; the tin cap hangs on a twine cord from a wire collar round the neck. Grip = body centre at origin. Glass: AlphaMode Transparency, Transparency 0.02.

assets.name: berries
assets.notes: Sprig of glossy wild berries (ripe dark red to a few lighter, 2.3-3.3 cm) on fine stalks from a woody twig with three leaves. Grip = cluster centre at origin.

assets.name: apple
assets.notes: 10 cm red apple: streaky blush over yellow-green ground colour, lenticel specks, waxy bloom, russet stem cavity, calyx basin, woody stem and one leaf. Grip = apple centre at origin.

assets.name: dried_meat
assets.notes: Smoke-cured shank of meat on the bone: dark crusted outside with pale fat seams and cracked pepper, a cut top face showing lean and marbling, two turns of twine; the hock bone sticks out below and is the grip (origin).

assets.name: ration
assets.notes: Tinplate ration tin with rolled double-seam rims, beading, a pull ring on the lid, rust at the seams; aged olive paper label (cream band, unreadable small print, rust-red rules). Grip = tin centre at origin.

assets.name: bandage
assets.notes: Roll of open-weave cotton gauze (axis X, wound layers on the dished ends) with the loose end hanging and two toothed steel clips. Grip = roll centre at origin.

assets.name: herbs
assets.notes: Bundle of fresh sage: seven square stems with soft grey-green, velvety, pebbled leaves in opposite pairs, tied with two turns of twine. Grip = the tie at origin.

assets.name: medkit
assets.notes: Rust-red waxed-canvas medic bag (white cross patch sewn on the front - not the protected red-on-white emblem), flap with two leather straps and brass buckles, riveted leather carry handle. Grip = the carry handle at origin; the bag hangs below.

assets.name: SupplyCrate1
assets.notes: Tier 1: plain crate of weathered, sun-silvered pine boards (raised grain, checks, rusty nail stains, grime and a little moss low down), diagonal braces, leather strap hinges. Lid = SupplyCrate1_Lid (opens ~100 degrees about LidHinge).

assets.name: SupplyCrate2
assets.notes: Tier 2: sturdier crate of warmer, less weathered pine with riveted bent-steel corner caps, a riveted tag plate, laid-rope handles through iron eyes on both ends. Lid = SupplyCrate2_Lid (+ SupplyCrate2_LidMetal corner caps riding on it).

assets.name: SupplyCrate3
assets.notes: Tier 3: dark-stained, iron-banded chest: blackened forged-iron corner angles, straps, lock plate, hasp and strap hinges (pitted, rust in the pits, worn bright on the edges), the arena's Spire 'Cleft' sigil burnt into the lid, a faint ember glow leaking from the lid seam (SupplyCrate3_Ember, separate Neon part). Lid = SupplyCrate3_Lid (+ SupplyCrate3_LidDarkMetal).

assets.name: leather_vest
assets.notes: Oil-tanned leather vest: pebbled grain, creases at the arm holes and waist, scuffed lighter edges, darker hand-worn trim at the hem and placket, three brass toggles, laced sides. Grip = back of the collar at origin (vest hangs below); 'Torso' = cavity centre for wearing.

assets.name: padded_armor
assets.notes: Quilted linen gambeson (vertical stitched channels, stuffed and puffy, faded and grubby), leather standing collar, placket and hem, three leather straps with brass buckles. Grip = back of the collar at origin; 'Torso' = cavity centre for wearing.

import: Swap-in for the v1 Items set: every asset keeps its v1 name, origin (Grip at the hand grip, crates on the floor centre), gameplay size and attachments (Grip, Tip, Nock, StringTop, StringBottom, ArrowRest, Mouth, Torso, LidHinge, Prompt, LootPoint) at the v1 positions, so ItemAssets.build() can switch manifests without code changes. Part lists are leaner (one MeshPart per surface group); the names the game relies on are kept: <Crate>_Lid (+ Lid-tagged fittings), SupplyCrate3_Ember, bow_Rope (the string), water_bottle_Glass / water_bottle_WaterFill / empty_bottle_Glass.

Geometry: import ItemsReal.glb (3D Importer / Open Cloud Model). Each asset root arrives as a Model of MeshParts named as in the manifest; re-centre with the asset 'origin' exactly like the v1 Items (WorldPivot = CFrame.new(origin), then PivotTo).

Surfaces: give every textured part ONE SurfaceAppearance from its 'surfaceAppearance' block: ColorMap / NormalMap / RoughnessMap / MetalnessMap = the uploaded ids of those PNGs in textures/ItemsReal (16 images for the whole set, each uploaded once and shared), AlphaMode as given, Color = 'color'. Do not rely on the importer's auto SurfaceAppearance for roughness/metalness: the GLB packs them into one glTF metallicRoughness image (glbOnlyTextures) which Roblox does not split. Clear any importer-created TextureID.

Glass and water (water_bottle_Glass, water_bottle_WaterFill, empty_bottle_Glass): AlphaMode = Transparency and MeshPart.Transparency = 0.02 (>= 0.02 makes the colour-map alpha blend smoothly; the alpha channel already carries the glass opacity: ~0.2 in thin walls, more at the base, shoulder and smudges). Every other part is opaque (AlphaMode Overlay with a fully opaque colour map; Transparency 0). No part relies on DoubleSided; keep MeshPart.DoubleSided = false.
SupplyCrate3_Ember is untextured: Material Neon, Color = rgb (236,112,44), or a plain part with EmissiveStrength; optionally a small orange PointLight (Range ~6, Brightness ~0.5) at LootPoint.

Per part: CanCollide = collide, CollisionFidelity = collision, CastShadow = castShadow, CanQuery = canQuery, CanTouch = canTouch; Material = robloxMaterial (physics/sounds only, the look comes from the SurfaceAppearance); 'rgb' = mean texture colour (fallback MeshPart.Color). Viewmodel / held copies: set CastShadow = false on every part (LookDevPlaybook 7.3); world loot copies use castShadow as listed.
Texel density (median px per stud, per asset) is in textureSets.<set>.pxPerStud; held items 170-260, crates and armour lower (large surfaces seen at arm's length).
